subject.title: fix(browser): restore Chrome page sharing on default gateways

question: Should the Browser plugin’s page-share service be a required default-Gateway startup service even when browser-control automation remains lazy?
rationale: This is a deliberate Gateway lifecycle and availability boundary, not a mechanical test-only change; the protected maintainer label requires explicit human handling.

options.title: Approve the split lifecycle
options.body: Accept unconditional startup of only the narrow page-share service after reviewing its failure behavior and fresh default-Gateway proof.

options.title: Keep the service opt-in
options.body: Retain the existing startup gate and pursue an alternative delivery-sink registration path if Gateway boot must remain fully independent of Browser service initialization.

recommendation.title: Approve the split lifecycle
recommendation.body: Accept unconditional startup of only the narrow page-share service after reviewing its failure behavior and fresh default-Gateway proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR context ties this person directly to the proposed Browser lifecycle boundary; independent feature-history attribution could not be completed here.
